theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_energy_lsc
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R E : ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (W h : Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < n → 0 < R → (∀ j, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (u j)) → (∀ j, ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ‖fderiv ℝ (u j) x‖ ^ 2 ≤ E) → MemLp W 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) R)) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, (u j x - c j - W x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 h (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) R)), h x = W x) → IntegrableOn (fun x => ‖fderiv ℝ h x‖ ^ 2) (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) ∧ ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ‖fderiv ℝ h x‖ ^ 2 ≤ E
